observation: Fresh same-browser 1640x920 evidence showed the target hero left copy beginning approximately 40-45px lower than the reference while the lower hero boundary stayed comparatively close.

known_preserved_owner.accessible_description: Öreg fa vastag törzzsel és nehéz alsó vezérággal, amelyet bronz támasz tart meg.

preconditions: Use the same browser engine for reference and target.
Start with 1640x920 to reproduce the existing observation before testing any additional viewport.
Match DPR, zoom, top-of-page/scroll position, sticky-header state, focus state and reduced-motion setting.
Wait for document fonts.ready plus hero image/SVG readiness before measuring.
Use only one reference and one target tab; never open replacement tabs because the connector is unstable.
Confirm target is page264 and page264 saved-data hash is reconciled before attributing drift to layout.
resolve_before_measure: Locate the source and target H1 by exact accessible/visible hero title rather than assuming matching DOM wrappers.
From each H1 walk to the smallest ancestor that owns the complete left hero copy column; record its selector/class/Elementor ID.
Record the hero root, inner layout owner, copy-column owner, H1, first body paragraph/lead, CTA group if present, art owner af2a0052 and the element immediately following the hero.
Do not compare generated Elementor wrapper IDs between source and target as if they were semantic equivalents; compare layout roles and computed ownership.
geometry_measurements_px: vertical delta from hero root top to copy column top
vertical delta from hero root top to H1 top
vertical delta from copy column bottom to hero root bottom
font_and_wrap_checks: Record document.fonts.status and the actual computed H1/body font families on both pages.
Record H1 and lead line counts; a line-wrap difference must be explained before changing vertical spacing.
If target uses the same vertical box model but text wraps differently, diagnose font/width ownership instead of adding top/bottom spacing.
If fonts are not ready or a different fallback wins, recapture after readiness; do not patch layout around a transient fallback.

classification_rules.whole_hero_offset: If root/inner padding or positioning differs by the measured amount and the next-section boundary shifts similarly, diagnose root/inner ownership.
classification_rules.copy_only_offset: If hero root/art/next-section geometry matches but copy-column top differs, diagnose copy-column align/justify/padding/margin/gap.
classification_rules.typography_wrap: If copy top aligns but H1/lead heights or line counts differ, diagnose width/font/line-height before spacing.
classification_rules.header_or_anchor_state: If root top differs while document/header states differ, normalize sticky/scroll state; do not change page264 hero.
classification_rules.no_single_owner: If several small differences combine to the observed 40-45px and no page264-local winner is proven, keep HOLD and make no write.

write_gate: A future fix must name the exact winning/losing declaration and responsible page264 selector or page264 element control.
The fix must not touch global header/footer, shared classes used by other pages, or af2a0052 art identity unless that owner is directly proven responsible.
Prefer the native Elementor owner/control when it exactly expresses the source value; use Additional CSS only for a proven non-native/page264-scoped exception.
After any future fix, require same-state source/target geometry readback plus adjacent-section regression check and unchanged content/AX contracts.
explicitly_forbidden_shortcuts: No blanket hero padding reduction from screenshot impression.
No content deletion or line-break insertion to force vertical alignment.
No global header offset fix from this page264 package.
No PIXEL_PASS claim from a single 1640x920 screenshot.
